name: Dessa Korr
lore: Dessa rebuilds dead machines with the patience of an undertaker. Every recovered brace, wire, and casket plate becomes another defence against the Reach.

abilities.name: Coffin Rigging
abilities.text: Once per round, after resolving Hollow Veil Sweep, recover Coffin Rig. Equip it if your Armor slot is empty.

abilities.name: Mortuary Triage
abilities.text: Once per round, after you Stabilize, ready one exhausted Gear you own.

abilities.name: Grave Spark
abilities.text: Passive. Add +1 Forge on tests in salvage or shop sectors.

abilities.name: Cold Brace
abilities.text: Once per round, when Wound damage would raise scenario pressure, reduce that pressure increase by 1. Weakness: Coffin Rigging cannot be used if you already gained Gear this turn.
